records.body:

draft.subject: Re: Bulk import — yes, there's a faster way
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Good news on your ticket: teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, so you won't have to add people one by one. Tariq still has that ticket open and will follow up there too.

Once your team is in, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them — that's usually the quickest way to see value.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the CSV invite and getting your first project started with you.

Best,
Chidi
